diagnosis: All rollouts passed Check C1 because the decision-maker chose the 'streaming' architecture, which is the only viable option according to PF1. Since all rollouts selected the same architecture without needing PF1's details, the check is effectively trivialized.

C1.why: The shared tests leave both architectures viable; Ravi's measured 18,000-event-per-minute burst changes the choice to streaming, sets the partition count to exactly 12, and requires a replay-capacity validation or partition-provisioning commitment.
